signals.usability_note: Clear view of a raised-ranch style house from the street across a front lawn; house is set back and partly screened by trees, with the roof only partly visible.

provider_truck.evidence: No commercial work vehicles are visible at the property.

yard_sign.evidence: No yard signs are visible on the lawn. A thin stake or flag-like marker stands in the grass but is not a readable sign.

professional_landscaping.evidence: The lawn is mowed, with a mulched bed and mature trees, but nothing shows crew-level work. This looks homeowner-maintained.

solar_panels.evidence: The visible roof surfaces show no panels.

signals.notes: Split-level/raised-ranch home with a two-car garage and a wide paved driveway that curves off to the left; mature evergreens and trees screen part of the frontage and a stone wall runs along the left side.
